title: pm-dispatch(runbook): 〈巡查常设项〉 spells the review claim as a `Claim:` comment and reads owed reviews off the label alone
body:
domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

Filing gate: ② two should-fixes of the contract review on PR #28759 (record 6561911910, SF-1 and SF-2), both on `main` before that PR and outside its card (#28740, a wording-only per-seat fix). Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:skills`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈巡查常设项〉 (L44, L45 on `main`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "Contract-review-claim" in:body → none relevant; "check-owed-reviews runbook" → none; "巡查常设项" → only #28740 (the per-seat wording, landing in PR #28759).
reach: every seat whose patrol runs the cross-account review item.

## What is inconsistent

- **SF-1:** the runbook's review item tells a reviewer to leave a `Claim:` comment (session, account) before reviewing. `contract-review.md` and `record-recognisers.mjs` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_TEMPLATE`, `readContractReviewClaim`) pin the review claim as `Contract-review-claim: <session> · <head full sha> · <UTC>`. That claim lapses after 2 h or when the head moves, and the lane seat wins ties. `check-owed-reviews.mjs` reads a `Claim:` comment as `missing`, so the rule 「不双做」 holds only in prose.
- **SF-2:** the runbook's patrol reads owed reviews off `label:needs:contract-review` alone. `contract-review.md` names `check-owed-reviews.mjs` as the owed list, and that list also covers face-owed PRs without the label, hand-offs, holds and lapsed claims.

## Wanted

- L45: the review claim is spelled as `contract-review.md` spells it, by its key name. No second spelling of the form.
- L44: the patrol reads the owed list from `check-owed-reviews.mjs`, not from the label search alone. The account-keyed self-exclusion stays: record 6561911910 ④ judged it right.
- Net line count 0, every line ≤ the file's byte cap. Tier S by the register (`.claude/**`).

Blocked-by: #28740
